Molded radiator hoses did not match the one in hand. Build the run from beaded couplings and cut hose. 90 is JEGS 555-511176 aluminum 1-1/2. 45 is 555-511181 aluminized steel. Straight is 555-511171. Legs are Gates 24024 cut short, O'Reilly https://www.oreillyauto.com/detail/c/vulco/gates-vulco-coolant-hose/gatg/24024 The radiator barb is 1-1/4, so 1-1/2 hose needs reducer 555-511285 on that end. Not bought yet.

spec.Build: Metal tube OD equals hose ID. Bead on each metal end. Clamp behind the bead. Two clamps per joint.
spec.Hose: Gates 24024, 1-1/2 in × 3 ft. Cut into short legs. Do not run the whole stick around the bend. O'Reilly: https://www.oreillyauto.com/detail/c/vulco/gates-vulco-coolant-hose/gatg/24024
spec.Radiator: This radiator's barb is 1-1/4 in. 1-1/2 hose needs JEGS 555-511285, the 8 in 1-1/2 to 1-1/4 reducer, on that end.
spec.Clamps: Worm size 28 on 1-1/2 hose. Gates 32028. Two per joint.
spec.Skip: Spectre 5166 is a clamp, not an elbow. Spectre intake tubing and PVC are not coolant.

JEGS 555-511181 aluminized steel 45, 1-1/2 in OD, legs 7 in and 3-3/4 in. Not aluminum. Amazon B00CO6NNVG.
JEGS 555-511171 aluminum straight, 1-1/2 in OD × 3 in. Speedway 9108251 is a 1.50 × 6 in pair.

Correction. The radiator-to-block hose has to bend, so Gates 24024 is the wrong hose. 24024 is a straight stick for straight connections. Buy Gates Vulco-Flex II. 25478 is 1-1/2 in by 17 in. 25474 is 12, 25476 is 14, 25480 is 20, 25482 is 22, 25484 is 25. Trim the plain cuffs. The old end looks about 1 mm bigger than 1-1/2 in. 1-1/2 in is 38 mm, so that is a worn opening, not the next size. 33 mm is 1.30 in, which is the 1-1/4 in flex hose, Gates 25253. Gates rates the 1-1/2 in flex hose about 30 psi. O'Reilly: https://www.oreillyauto.com/detail/c/vulco-flex-ii/engine-cooling/radiator-hose/b0a07a12b12d/gates-vulco-flex-ii-coolant-hose/gatc/25478/v/a/15820/automotive-truck-1956-jeep-willys Not bought yet.

spec.Size: 1-1/2 in inside, 38 mm. Old end looks about 1 mm larger from wear.
spec.33 mm: 33 mm is 1.30 in. That is Gates 25253, the 1-1/4 in flex hose.
spec.Shape: 24024 is a straight stick. This run bends. Do not buy it.
spec.Buy: Vulco-Flex II, 1-1/2 in. 25474 is 12 in, 25476 is 14 in, 25478 is 17 in, 25480 is 20 in, 25482 is 22 in, 25484 is 25 in. Trim the plain cuffs.
spec.Pressure: About 30 psi on the Gates page for this diameter. GM 3.0 manual says not to pressure-test above 20 psi.

log.text: Stop buying molded hoses. The burst run is being built from couplings. 90 is JEGS 555-511176 aluminum, 1-1/2 OD, 3-1/4 in legs, Amazon B07HBBSTQS, Speedway 32-1001-1.50. 45 is JEGS 555-511181 aluminized steel, not aluminum, legs 7 in and 3-3/4 in, Amazon B00CO6NNVG. Straight is JEGS 555-511171 aluminum 1-1/2 × 3 in, or Speedway 9108251 6 in pair. Cut Gates 24024 into short legs. O'Reilly: https://www.oreillyauto.com/detail/c/vulco/gates-vulco-coolant-hose/gatg/24024 Do not run 24024 as one piece around the bend. The radiator barb is 1-1/4, JEGS 555-53082, so 1-1/2 hose needs reducer 555-511285 on that end, or build the whole run in 1-1/4 with 555-511175, 555-511170, and 24020. Stainless 90 is Filler Neck Supply D150A90SS. Size 28 worm clamps, two per joint. Not bought yet.
